fragen.text: Are you about equally in love, or does one of you feel the love more strongly?
Which of you shows affection and closeness more openly in everyday life?
Is one of you more invested in their career?
Which of you brings work topics or stress into the relationship more often?
Do you handle your finances together, or does one of you tend to take the lead?
Which of you plans spending and savings goals more actively?
Which of you struggles more often with health limitations or low energy?
Which of you recovers more slowly from strain or illness?
Do you share a circle of friends, or does one of you have clearly more friends of their own?
Which of you is more likely to start joint activities with others?
Which of you is the more creative mind in your relationship?
Which of you brings new ideas or unconventional solutions into everyday life more often?
Which of you brings change into your shared life more often – a move, a new job, trying something completely new?
Which of you deals more openly with upheaval and change?
How do you two stand on spirituality, religion or the supernatural – are you balanced, or is one of you more rational and down-to-earth?
Which of you relies more on intuition or gut feeling in important decisions?
